newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms as interest rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms as interest rates rise.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar firmed to 475.50/476.50 per dollar as investors bought bolivars to take advantage of rising yields in Central Bank TEM paper, traders said.
On Tuesday the unit closed at 476/477 per dollar.
"Foreign investors sold a lot of dollars to buy into TEMs," said one trader.
Yields on six month TEMs, which act as a benchmark for wider interest rates, rose 91 basis points to 18.45 percent at the Central Bank's regular Wednesday auction.
The bank sold 40 billion bolivars ($82 million) worth of the paper.
